diagnosis: JEV-specific IgM antibody test in cerebrospinal fluid (CSF) or serum
transmission: Transmission cycle between mosquitoes, pigs and/or water birds (enzootic cycle)
risk_factors: Living in or having travelled to a JE-endemic area
complications: Permanent cognitive, behavioural or neurological sequelae
Speech, language, memory, and communication problems
key_facts: Case-fatality rate among those with encephalitis can be as high as 30%
